text:
noah: Hi all, first-week snag. I'm on a company Win11 laptop and Okta insists I register a passkey but my YubiKey 5Ci isn't showing up in the browser. Edge shows "No security keys found". Also 1Password desktop app accepted my invite but says "Account claimed by another org" when I try to sign in. Lastly, I can't reach the dev bastion over SSH (timeout). Who should I bug?

lee: Welcome Noah! :wave: For Win11 + YubiKey try: Device Manager -> Human Interface Devices and look for YubiKey. Also ensure Edge has security key support enabled (edge://flags) and try chrome if you can.

noah: Device Manager shows a YubiKey listed under USB devices but the browser still fails. I tried reboot and different USB-C port.

it-help: Hi @noah, opening IT-2592. Can you run these in Powershell and paste output? `Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match "YubiKey" }` and `certutil -scinfo` (might prompt). Also which 1Password invite email did you accept?

noah: Ran the first command, output: 
```
InstanceId : USB\VID_1050&PID_0127\6&2b3f8b8a&0&3
Class       : USB
FriendlyName: YubiKey 5Ci
Status      : OK
```
1Password invite was to noah.personal@gmail; I accepted before getting corporate invite to noah@redwood.com.

lee: Ah that explains account conflict. @people-ops can reassign or revoke the personal acceptance and resend. People-ops, can you handle?

people-ops: On it, filed PEOPLE-4821 to transfer the seat. We'll revoke the personal claim and resend to noah@redwood.com within the hour.

it-help: Re: browser key: Edge/Chrome may block access if an enterprise policy disables WebAuthn. Check Registry: `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome\AllowEnrollment` (or equivalent Edge policy). Also try `Security Key` enrollment via Okta mobile app as a fallback (Okta mobile can register platform passkeys).

noah: Tried Chrome incognito and still same error. Okta shows option to register "Security Key (USB)" but registration fails at test step.

lee: Two quick workarounds: 1) Register the key using your phone (Lightning on 5Ci) via Okta mobile if available. 2) For SSH, use the web-based Cloud Shell temporary access: https://bastion.redwood.internal/cloudshell — that'll unblock you while we fix key.

noah: Cloud shell worked, thanks. But I'd like the physical key working for MFA/SSO.

it-help: FYI I tried forcing a Windows driver reinstall remotely; seems the YubiKey HID interface is fine. Next step: check group policy and browser enterprise settings. If those don't fix it, bring the key and laptop to my desk and I'll test with a Linux live USB and alternate browser.

ops-bot: IT-2592 created and assigned to it-help. People ops ticket PEOPLE-4821 created.

people-ops: Seat transferred and new invite sent to noah@redwood.com. Reply here when you accept and we'll mark PEOPLE-4821 resolved.

noah: Accepted the corporate 1Password invite, good to go there.

lee: One more note for SSH timeout: check corp VPN is connected; bastion enforces IP allowlist. If you see `ssh -vvv bastion` output showing TCP timeout before auth, ping bastion IP to confirm network.

noah: Confirmed VPN was off 5. Reconnected and can reach bastion via cloud shell and direct SSH now.

it-help: Marking IT-2592 status = In Progress. If browser policies are the root cause we'll loop in SecOps to allow WebAuthn for enrolled browsers.

noah: All unblocked at the moment. Appreciate the quick triage and the cloud-shell workaround :relieved:

ops-bot: IT-2592 updated: it-help assigned, status=In Progress; PEOPLE-4821 closed by people-ops.
